    • withConsent

      @Contract(value="_, _, _ -> new", pure=true) public SimpleConfig withConsent(boolean submitMetrics, boolean additionalMetrics, boolean errorTracking)
      Creates a copy of this config that reflects the consent given on the consent screen.

      FastStats is enabled if either metrics submission or error tracking was allowed, and additional metrics require metrics submission.

      Parameters:
      submitMetrics - whether metrics submission was allowed
      additionalMetrics - whether additional metrics were allowed
      errorTracking - whether error tracking was allowed
      Returns:
      the new config, marked as having shown the consent screen
